rows.summary: Full support: structured feed, web approvals, live comments, model switch.
rows.approvals: ✅ gated from the web or tmux popup; fails closed
rows.first_message: ✅ channel push; held until the channel connects

rows.summary: Structured feed from codex's rollout file, web approvals, live comments.
rows.approvals: ✅ gated (PreToolUse hook); fails closed. Off with `--no-permissions`, `--yolo`, `-a never`
rows.first_message: ✅ typed into the composer once it is drawn (waits up to 20 s; session notice if it never is)

rows.summary: Structured feed; comments arrive when codex polls for them.
rows.capture: ✅ rollout file, codex in a PTY
rows.comments: ⚠ codex pulls them via the `poll_viewer_messages` channel tool (`LIVE_CHANNEL=0` turns it off)
rows.first_message: ❌ waits for codex to call `poll_viewer_messages`; an idle codex never does
rows.gaps: comments wait until codex calls the channel tool; no model switch

rows.summary: Headless codex driven over app-server: structured feed, web approvals, comments as turns.
rows.approvals: ✅ answered from the web; deny on timeout
rows.comments: ✅ steer the running turn, or start a new one
rows.first_message: ✅ starts a turn (held on the server until the thread is open)
rows.gaps: file approvals say only "apply a file change"; no terminal UI; codex questions get no answers; no model switch

rows.summary: Structured feed and web approvals; replies appear when the turn ends.
rows.approvals: ✅ gated; fails closed; live exits if the plugin can't install
rows.comments: ✅ every comment in full, at the next model step
rows.first_message: ✅ typed in once the composer is ready (waits up to 20 s, confirms, retries once; notice names trust/sign-in)
rows.handoff: ⚠ prior context shown in the pane and saved as a digest; agy has no system-prompt flag and `-i` would start a turn, so it isn't given to agy
rows.gaps: reply arrives when the turn ends; no model switch

rows.summary: Structured feed and web approvals via hooks; comments are typed in when idle, else land at tool or turn boundaries.
rows.approvals: ⚠ gated, fails closed — but gemini's own prompt stays in charge when hooks may not fire (hooks/extensions disabled, allowlist, GitHub Actions, your own `--yolo`/`--approval-mode`)
rows.comments: ✅ typed into the composer while idle; at tool and turn boundaries while busy (tmux runs; without tmux, boundaries only)
rows.first_message: ✅ typed in once gemini is idle at its composer (waits up to 20 s, confirms, retries once; notice names trust/sign-in); mid-turn it waits for the next hook
rows.handoff: ⚠ not given to the agent — prior context shown in the terminal and saved as a digest file
rows.gaps: untrusted folder: approve twice; env redaction strips `LIVE_TOKEN` (capture off, gated tools denied); without tmux comments wait while idle; no model switch

rows.summary: Old gemini: terminal recording only. Upgrade to 0.26+ for hooks.
rows.approvals: ❌ gemini's own prompt, in the terminal only
rows.handoff: ⚠ not given to the agent — prior context shown in the terminal and saved as a digest file

rows.summary: Local chat REPL: replies stream as lines; comments are typed in.
rows.first_message: ✅ typed in as one line once ollama is idle at its prompt; an early one waits for it
rows.handoff: ⚠ not given to the agent — prior context shown in the terminal and saved as a digest file
rows.gaps: no prompt/tool rows, no stream_end, no model

rows.summary: Any agent that speaks ACP: structured feed, web approvals, comments as turns — no per-agent adapter.
rows.approvals: ✅ answered from the web; fails closed
rows.comments: ✅ sent as the next turn (queued while one runs)
rows.first_message: ✅ sent as the first turn (held on the server until the ACP session is open)
rows.handoff: ✅ digest prepended to the first turn
rows.gaps: no terminal UI; comments wait for the running turn; no model switch

rows.summary: Terminal recording only: viewers see raw output; approvals stay in the terminal.
rows.approvals: ❌ the agent's own prompt, in the terminal only
rows.comments: ⚠ typed in at the agent's prompt when it is idle (the named agents; any other command only with `type_comments` in agents.json or `LIVE_TYPE_COMMENTS=1`)
rows.model_choice: ⚠ `cursor-agent` (`--model`), or any agent given `models` + `model_flag` in agents.json
rows.first_message: ⚠ typed in once output is quiet and no dialog is on screen (echo confirmed, Enter retried once; session notice after 20 s). A heuristic, not yet checked per agent; `ready_pattern` in agents.json pins the prompt
rows.handoff: ⚠ not given to the agent — prior context shown in the terminal and saved as a digest file
rows.gaps: no prompt/reply/tool rows, no stream_end, no model. Speaks ACP? Run it in ACP mode (row above)
